entities.name: Fall of the Western Roman Empire
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The deposition of the last Western Roman Emperor Romulus Augustulus in 476 CE, marking the end of ancient Western civilization. Caused by barbarian invasions, internal decay, and economic collapse, it ushered in the Medieval period.
